<reasoning>
The compile error comes from a stray closing brace "}" after the CUDA kernel, which breaks the surrounding host and pybind11 code, causing cascading “expected a declaration” and undefined identifier errors. I removed that extra brace and also launched the kernel with stream.stream() to pass the actual cudaStream_t explicitly. No other logic was changed.
</reasoning>
